title: Machine-Checked Exact-Rational Koashi-Imoto Decomposition, Qubit Dichotomy, and Pure-Atom Certificates for Holevo-Rate Visible Compression
abstract: Polloreno (arXiv:2611.33129, November 24, 2026) resolved when visible compression of a finite memoryless quantum source {p_x, omega_x} with shared classical randomness achieves the Holevo rate R_cr = chi: in the maximal Koashi-Imoto (KI) decomposition omega_x = direct_sum_j p(j|x) rho_x^j (x) xi_j, achievability holds if and only if every occupied quantum core rho_x^j is pure, reducing for qubits to the dichotomy that all signals are pure or commute pairwise. We present a machine-checked, zero-floating-point formalization and certificate auditing framework for the finite-dimensional algebraic core of this criterion. First, we build an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel (KoashiImotoHolevo.lean, Lean 4.35.0; 0 sorry, 0 warnings, 0 Classical.choice) certifying exact Bloch purity and linear-entropy defects, cross-product commutator antisymmetry/collinearity, the 3D Lagrange identity |a x b|^2 + (a.b)^2 = |a|^2 |b|^2, strict convex purity drop along off-center chords, 2x2 Cayley-Hamilton rank-1 idempotence and commutator criteria, full 16-entry 4x4 KI Kronecker purity multiplicativity, the visible/blind rate sandwich and separation (R_cr = chi < R_blind), decomposition-cost excess, Proposition 9 partial additivity, inductive Proposition 10 sector-splitting excess and all-cores-zero biconditional rigidity, and Lemma 3 Caratheodory positivity |X|d^2 + 1 >= 2. Second, we define KOASHI-IMOTO-CERT-1.0 and a pure-stdlib zero-float verifier (using exact rational LDL^T PSD checks and Wedderburn/Schur trivial-commutant Gaussian elimination) spanning four modes. Across 16 canonical certificates, zero-float replay executes in 0.075-0.655 ms, passes independent exact-Q[i] Hermitian and PSD cross-checks, and rejects 57/57 live adversarial forgeries.
